text:
kelly: acme tenant onboarding failing intermittently. SCIM create sometimes returns 409 but idp console shows no user. audit index missing user.create rows around 2026-03-18T15:12Z. anyone seen this?

sam: paste provisioning logs pls. 409 + missing audit usually indicates our create aborted but idp recorded a duplicate from another worker.

kelly: log snippet:
```
2026-03-18T15:11:58Z INFO provisioning: start create externalId=acme-ops-4421
2026-03-18T15:12:00Z ERROR kms-client: Decrypt failed: AccessDenied
2026-03-18T15:12:00Z ERROR provisioning: abort create due to kms decrypt
2026-03-18T15:12:02Z ERROR scim-client: HTTP 409 Conflict {"detail": "User with externalId already exists"}
```

anika: KMS AccessDenied is the root. Did you rotate the provisioning role? alias vs key policy can bite you.

kelly: yes rotated last night.

sam: run these as the service principal: `aws sts get-caller-identity`, `aws kms list-grants --key-id <key-id>`, `aws kms get-key-policy --key-id <key-id>`. Likely grant points to old role.

kelly: list-grants shows grant for old role ARN; new role missing.

jonah: remediation: create grant allowing Decrypt+GenerateDataKey for new role or update key policy. also replay provisioning DLQ to restore missing audit rows. add smoke test for kms decrypt after role rotation.

kelly: created grant, retried onboarding: new users 201. replayed DLQ for 15:10-15:20 and restored audit rows. asked acme to pin SAML NameIDFormat to persistent to avoid duplicate extId races.

infra-bot: started DLQ replay job id rpl-20260318-01; job completed.

sam: postmortem notes: root cause = role rotation without updating CMK grants; contributing = idp transient NameID causing mis-linking. remediations: update onboarding docs, add rotation checklist to update grants and run `aws kms decrypt` smoke test, alert on KMS:Decrypt AccessDenied spikes.

kelly: closing, no new 409s in 45m. thanks all :tada:
